title: 第五章王府崛起第六章恶毒的女人
content_zh:
三个月后。
叶北城，王府内！
只见王府里面，到处张灯结彩，似有什么喜事一般。
王府门前，更是有不少人带着礼品，登门拜访。
大街上，不少寻常老百姓都围观在王府门前，指指点点，议论着什么。
“啧啧，这次王府怕是要扬名了。”
“那可不是，据说王家的千金，就在昨日踏入了神武境，成为了叶北城有史以来最快踏入神武境的天才。整个叶北城都为之轰动，就连远在千里之外的大夏皇朝，都特地派了三皇子前来恭贺。”
“不仅是大夏皇朝，还有附近的一流宗门，望月宗也派了一位招收长老，想来收王依依进入望月宗。”
“这下叶北城怕是要彻底被王家所掌控了。”
“谁说不是呢，城主府的那位千金如今还在三玄境八品，距离神武境还有着不小的距离。至于苏家....哎，若是当年那位天才，苏阳未曾消失的话。恐怕，也轮不到王家今日这般扬眉吐气了。”
“嘘，小声点。可别让王府的人听见了，到时候小心你的舌头不保。”
“....”
“驾~！”
“驾~！”
“快看，是苏家的人来了。”
“没错，那是苏家的大长老，如今的苏家家主，苏北楼。”
“也不知道苏家现在与王家的关系如何，好歹当年也是联姻亲家，不过现在看来，王家怕是要不认这个亲家了。”
“.....”
“欢迎苏家主大驾光临，我们家主以及城主大人早已恭候多时。”门前一名小厮见状，急忙笑脸相迎道。
然而，苏北楼的神情，却并不怎么好看。

他好歹也在叶北城，摸爬滚打几十年，岂会不知道今日过后，苏家与王家的差距将会越来越远....甚至，以后苏家都有可能会不复存在。
“哼！”苏北楼冷哼一声，带着几位苏家高手，便踏入了房间之中。
小厮见状，倒也不气，依旧笑脸相迎，随时恭候其余送礼之人。
....
王府内，大厅！
苏北楼刚走进去，一道爽朗笑声便响起道：“哈哈哈，北楼兄，未能亲自迎接，还望见谅啊。”
王朗端坐在太师椅上，面色红润的看着苏北楼，丝毫没有起身之意。
苏北楼一眼扫去，脸上的神情也随之跟着变化起来。
因为此刻坐在王府大厅里的人，无一例外，全部都是大人物。
content_en:
Three months later.
Ye Beicheng, inside the palace!
I saw that inside the palace, there were lanterns and colorful lights everywhere, as if there was some happy event.
In front of the palace, many people came to visit with gifts.
On the street, many ordinary people gathered in front of the palace, pointing and talking about something.
"Tsk, tsk, I'm afraid the palace will become famous this time."
"That's not true. It is said that the daughter of the Wang family entered the realm of divine martial arts just yesterday, becoming the fastest genius in the history of Ye Beicheng to enter the realm of divine martial arts. The whole Ye Beicheng was shocked by this, and even the Great Xia Dynasty, thousands of miles away, specially sent the third prince to congratulate her."
"Not only the Great Xia Dynasty, but also the nearby first-class sects, the Wangyue Sect also sent a recruitment elder to recruit Wang Yiyi into the Wangyue Sect."
"Now Ye Beicheng may be completely controlled by the Wang family."
"Who says otherwise? The daughter of the City Lord's Mansion is still at the eighth level of the Three Mysteries Realm, and is still far away from the Divine Martial Realm. As for the Su family... Well, if that genius Su Yang hadn't disappeared, I'm afraid it wouldn't be the Wang family's turn to be as proud as they are today."
"Shh, keep your voice down. Don't let the people in the palace hear you. Be careful about your tongue."
"...."
"Drive~!"
"Drive~!"
"Look, it's people from the Su family here."
"Yes, that is the eldest elder of the Su family and the current head of the Su family, Su Beilou."
"I don't know what the relationship between the Su family and the Wang family is now. At any rate, they were married to in-laws back then, but now it seems that the Wang family is afraid that they will disown this in-laws."
"..."
"Welcome, Master Su. Our Master and the City Master have been waiting for you for a long time." Seeing this, a young man in front of the door greeted him with a smile.
However, Su Beilou's expression was not very good-looking.
After all, he was also in Ye Beicheng, struggling for decades. How could he not know that after today, the gap between the Su family and the Wang family would become wider and wider... In fact, the Su family might even cease to exist in the future.
"Hmph!" Su Beilou snorted coldly and stepped into the room with several Su family masters.
When the young man saw this, he was not angry at all. He still greeted him with a smile and was always waiting for the other gift-givers.
....
In the palace, the hall!
As soon as Su Beilou walked in, a hearty laugh rang out: "Hahaha, Brother Beilou, I apologize for not being able to greet you in person."
Wang Lang was sitting on the Grand Master's chair, looking at Su Beilou with a rosy face, without any intention of getting up.
Su Beilou glanced away, and the expression on his face changed accordingly.
Because the people sitting in the palace hall at this moment, without exception, are all big shots.
